# Torrently

> Torrently plays, streams and downloads torrents in the browser. A user pastes a magnet link or opens a .torrent file; Torrently's servers download the torrent and serve its files over HTTPS, so video plays and files download without a torrent client on the user's device. Torrently works only with the torrents and magnet links its users bring: it is not a torrent index or a search engine.

## What Torrently does

- Plays video and audio from a torrent or magnet link in the browser. Formats the browser cannot play (MKV, AVI and others) are transcoded to HLS on the fly.
- Downloads any single file of a torrent by a direct HTTPS link, or a folder or the whole torrent as one TAR or ZIP archive.
- Shows subtitles: tracks inside the file, subtitle files the user uploads, and subtitles looked up on OpenSubtitles.
- Converts a magnet link to a .torrent file and back.
- Works as a cloud torrent client: the download happens on Torrently's servers, not on the user's device.
- Works without registration for playing and downloading.

Playback starts once enough of the file has arrived from the swarm. How long that takes depends on the torrent's seeders; a torrent that nobody seeds cannot be played or downloaded.

## What Torrently is not

- Not a torrent index or search engine: Torrently keeps no index or catalogue of torrents of its own. It plays the torrents and magnet links its users bring, including those from sources a user connects to their account (their own Stremio addons or Torznab indexers).
- Not a content host: nothing is published on Torrently. Torrent data is fetched from the BitTorrent network when a user opens a torrent and cached only temporarily, unless a paying user saves the torrent to Vault.
- Not an anonymity service. Connections to Torrently use HTTPS, and the user's IP address does not join the swarm, because Torrently's servers do the downloading. Torrently itself sees which torrents and files a user requests.

## With an account

- [Library]({{DOMAIN}}/lib/): torrents the user has saved, with playback progress.
- [Discover]({{DOMAIN}}/discover): a catalogue of movie and series metadata. The streams listed for a title come from the Stremio addons and Torznab indexers the user has connected; Torrently does not supply them.
- [Stremio addon]({{DOMAIN}}/torrently-stremio-addon) (paid plans): the user's library in Stremio, plus the user's own Stremio addons played through Torrently. The torrent downloads on Torrently's servers, so the user's device never joins the swarm.
- [WebDAV]({{DOMAIN}}/instructions/webdav) and [S3]({{DOMAIN}}/instructions/s3) access to the library, for players such as VLC, Infuse or Kodi and for file managers (paid plans).
- Vault (paid plans): keeps a torrent stored on Torrently so it stays available when the swarm is gone.
- [New release emails]({{DOMAIN}}/torrent-rss-alternative): an email when a new release of a followed movie or season appears on the user's own indexers and Stremio addons.

## Plans

Free use needs no registration. The paid plans and their current prices are on {{DOMAIN}}/donate.

## Tools

- [Torrent → Direct Download]({{DOMAIN}}/torrent-to-ddl): direct HTTPS download links for the files of a torrent.
- [Torrent → ZIP]({{DOMAIN}}/torrent-to-zip): a torrent's files as one archive.
- [Magnet to Direct Download]({{DOMAIN}}/magnet-to-ddl): direct HTTPS download links for the files behind a magnet link.
- [Magnet → Torrent]({{DOMAIN}}/magnet-to-torrent): a .torrent file from a magnet link.
- [Torrent → Magnet]({{DOMAIN}}/torrent-to-magnet): the magnet link and info hash of a .torrent file.
- [Torrent → Stream]({{DOMAIN}}/torrent-to-stream): a torrent's video as an HLS stream.
- [Torrent → MP4]({{DOMAIN}}/torrent-to-mp4): why a .torrent file needs no converter, and how to play or download the video inside it.
- [Watch torrents online]({{DOMAIN}}/watch-torrents-online): playing a torrent's video in the browser without downloading it first.
- [Watch torrents on iOS]({{DOMAIN}}/watch-torrents-ios): playing and downloading torrents on iPhone and iPad without an app.
- [uTorrent Web alternative]({{DOMAIN}}/utorrent-web-alternative): a torrent client that runs in any browser with nothing to install; how it compares with uTorrent Web.
- [How to open a .torrent file]({{DOMAIN}}/open-torrent-file): opening a .torrent file without installing a client.
- [How to download torrented files]({{DOMAIN}}/how-to-download-torrent-files): getting the files out of a torrent from the browser.
- [How to open torrents on a PC]({{DOMAIN}}/open-torrents-on-pc): opening torrents on Windows without installing a client.
- [Online torrent downloader]({{DOMAIN}}/online-torrent-downloader): downloading torrents and magnet links in the browser.
- [Stream torrent online]({{DOMAIN}}/stream-torrent-online): streaming a torrent or magnet link in the browser.
- [Online torrent player]({{DOMAIN}}/torrent-player): a browser player for the video files of a torrent.
- [Web torrent client]({{DOMAIN}}/web-torrent-client): streaming and downloading torrents from any device's browser.
- [Cloud torrent client]({{DOMAIN}}/cloud-torrent-client): torrents downloaded on Torrently's servers; the user's device never joins the swarm.
- [Stremio online]({{DOMAIN}}/stremio-addons-online): a web player for the user's Stremio addon catalogues, for devices where the Stremio app cannot play torrents.
- [Torrently Stremio addon]({{DOMAIN}}/torrently-stremio-addon): the user's own torrents and magnet links in Stremio on a TV, phone or tablet (paid plans).
- [Debrid alternative for Stremio]({{DOMAIN}}/debrid-alternative): the Torrently Stremio addon in place of or alongside a debrid service; with the user's own Real-Debrid or TorBox connected, the files it has cached play through it at no charge from Torrently, and Torrently's servers play the rest (paid plans).
- [Torrent RSS alternative]({{DOMAIN}}/torrent-rss-alternative): email alerts for new releases found on the user's own indexers and Stremio addons.

## Developers
